name: Barbados Efoil
summary: An efoil school on the west coast of Barbados, teaching people to ride electric hydrofoil boards. Certified Fliteboard instructors run one-off Discover Flights, multi-lesson Progression packages and private group sessions. It is operated by Caribbean eFoil, a Barbados registered company.
standouts: Fliteboard authorised partner badge shown on the site
Operated by Caribbean eFoil, a Barbados registered company

checkNotes: Thin, new site (Squarespace, set up mid 2026). Only the home page has real content; About, Contact, Appointments and Shop still carry template text, a demo appointment calendar (blueprintcatalogen.as.me) and placeholder products at $25, so none of those are used. All booking goes through one site-wide FareHarbor button (not opened); no prices, durations or times on the site. The site shows no phone, email or address, only a contact form and an Instagram handle; our list has +1 246-240-7412. Town is Holetown from our list: the site only says the Platinum Coast. Home page says riders can also rent a board or buy one, with no details. Gallery captions on the home page say an official Flite Service Center opens in November and announce the Flite School opening, so the business may be newly launched.
